en.text: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华论以色列的默示。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華論以色列的默示。

en.text: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 「我必使耶路撒冷被围困的时候，向四围列国的民成为令人昏醉的杯；这默示也论到犹大。

zhTraditional.text: 「我必使耶路撒冷被圍困的時候，向四圍列國的民成為令人昏醉的杯；這默示也論到猶大。

en.text: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻击他的万民当作一块重石头；凡举起的必受重伤。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻擊他的萬民當作一塊重石頭；凡舉起的必受重傷。

en.text: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：到那日，我必使一切马匹惊惶，使骑马的颠狂。我必看顾犹大家，使列国的一切马匹瞎眼。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：到那日，我必使一切馬匹驚惶，使騎馬的顛狂。我必看顧猶大家，使列國的一切馬匹瞎眼。

en.text: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’

zhSimplified.text: 犹大的族长必心里说：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠万军之耶和华—他们的 神，就作我们的能力。』

zhTraditional.text: 猶大的族長必心裏說：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠萬軍之耶和華－他們的上帝，就作我們的能力。』

en.text: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 「那日，我必使犹大的族长如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆里；他们必左右烧灭四围列国的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本处，就是耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 「那日，我必使猶大的族長如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆裏；他們必左右燒滅四圍列國的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本處，就是耶路撒冷。

en.text: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華必先拯救猶大的帳棚，免得大衛家的榮耀和耶路撒冷居民的榮耀勝過猶大。

en.text: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民。他们中间软弱的必如大卫；大卫的家必如 神，如行在他们前面之耶和华的使者。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，耶和華必保護耶路撒冷的居民。他們中間軟弱的必如大衛；大衛的家必如上帝，如行在他們前面之耶和華的使者。

en.text: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，我必定意滅絕來攻擊耶路撒冷各國的民。

en.text: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

footnotes.text: 12:10 After “me”, the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet), not as a word, but as a grammatical marker.

zhSimplified.text: 「我必将那施恩叫人恳求的灵，浇灌大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民。他们必仰望我，就是他们所扎的；必为我悲哀，如丧独生子，又为我愁苦，如丧长子。

zhTraditional.text: 「我必將那施恩叫人懇求的靈，澆灌大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民。他們必仰望我，就是他們所扎的；必為我悲哀，如喪獨生子，又為我愁苦，如喪長子。

en.text: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈达临门的悲哀。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈達臨門的悲哀。

en.text: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

zhSimplified.text: 境内一家一家地都必悲哀。大卫家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。拿单家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

zhTraditional.text: 境內一家一家地都必悲哀。大衛家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。拿單家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。

en.text: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

zhSimplified.text: 利未家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。示每家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

zhTraditional.text: 利未家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。示每家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。

en.text: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的各家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的各家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
